# MotoVault

> AI-powered motorcycle learning and diagnostics platform

MotoVault helps motorcycle riders maintain, diagnose, and learn about their bikes using artificial intelligence. Available on iOS and Android.

## Core Features

- [AI Diagnostics](https://motovault.app/features/ai-diagnostics): Describe symptoms in plain language and get actionable diagnostic guidance powered by Claude AI
- [Learning Paths](https://motovault.app/features/learning-paths): Structured motorcycle maintenance courses with interactive quizzes
- [Garage Management](https://motovault.app/features/garage-management): Track multiple motorcycles, service history, and upcoming maintenance
- [Progress Tracking](https://motovault.app/features/progress-tracking): Monitor your motorcycle knowledge growth and skill development

## Tools

- [Cost Calculator](https://motovault.app/tools/cost-calculator): Calculate true motorcycle cost of ownership
- [TCLOCS Checklist](https://motovault.app/tools/tclocs-checklist): Interactive pre-ride safety inspection

## Blog

- [Motorcycle Maintenance Blog](https://motovault.app/blog): 27+ articles covering maintenance guides, brand-specific schedules, troubleshooting, and DIY tutorials
